local_changes: 2026-10-26 rombios.h: BX_PCIBIOS, BX_APM and BX_PNPBIOS set to 0; pc386 has no PCI bus, APM or PnP. rombios.c: the POST call to pci_set_pam_regs_ro is built only with BX_PCIBIOS, as it does not assemble without it.
2026-10-26 rombios.c: INT 16h AH=03h AL=00h/05h sets the typematic rate and delay through keyboard command F3h; INT 16h AH=09h reports AX=0300h and 0305h as supported.

2026-11-01 rombios.c: POST gates A20 off for the OS through both pc386 controls, the 8042 output port (D0h, then D1h with bit 1 clear and bit 0 set) and port 92h bit 1; set_enable_a20 drives both and INT 15h AX=2402h reports the state memory sees (get_enable_a20, a wrap test at 500h).

2026-11-03 rombios.c, rombios.h: POST programs PIT counter 1, the refresh timer, as an AT BIOS does (binary, LSB only, mode 2, count 18 = 15.09 us), so port 61h bit 4 toggles and INT 15h AH=86h returns; rombios.h names port 41h PORT_PIT_COUNTER1.
